This is occurrence #20 (last_notified_at 2026-07-31T11:24:00Z, ~24h48m ago \u2014 exceeded the 24h suppression window).
Owning team (would tag \u2014 not tagged): `CRM Experience`
Playbook: Re-query p95:trace.aspnet.request{service:notifications,env:prod} over the monitor's own last_10m window plus a wider surrounding window (expect 0.001-0.2s, nowhere near the 1s threshold); confirm 0 error logs; escalate only if a genuine elevated p95 ever appears.
Open Jira: n/a \u2014 fix_jira not set

Source alerts (1 total):

  \u2022 DD metric (coarse ~20s rollup, same window widened ±30min): same minute maxes at 0.0315s \u2014 spike vanishes at coarser resolution, reconfirming the rollup-artifact mechanism
  \u2022 DD logs: service:notifications status:error env:prod and service:notifications env:prod (spike-minute sanity check) \u2014 0 hits both
  \u2022 Kibana: n/a \u2014 not the evidence datasource for this KB (evidence_source: datadog_apm)
